name: Fortune
description: Fortune is Annie Flash's horned, horse-like companion on Thunder Junction, and the same name also appears in Aetherdrift pages as an Endriders road warrior.

bio.text: In the Aetherdrift pages, a Far Fortune of the Endriders faced the demon's veil and unleashed the Endriders' blaze.

bio.text: The Endriders were later caught in a pit, and in the final Aetherdrift episode racers, including some wrecked ones, were turned by Jace's spell to attack Chandra.

status.text: As of January 2025 the Aetherdrift Fortune appears among racers whose eyes were turned white by Jace's spell; the Thunder Junction horse's last event shows Annie and Kellan escaping on Fortune in March 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie Flash follows the smoke on Fortune, recognises Akul's work in the burned carriage and finds an untouched lockbox of cash.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 1: An Offer of Revenge" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie summons Fortune and rides to Rustwood following Oko's matchbook.
timeline.quote: Annie took Oko's matchbook from her pocket and looked at the black lettering once more.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 2: The Jailbreak" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie returns to her farm and checks in with Fortune, then goes to her sick nephew Tommy.
timeline.quote: Tommy is in bed when she walks in his room, awake and staring out the window.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Blood Is Thicker than Venom" by H.E. Edgmon. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie arrives on Fortune and carries Nolan and Umezawa away from the train.
timeline.quote: Annie steered Fortune toward safety and broke into a fearless gallop

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Annie returns and holds off the Sterling riders while the passengers jump from the train.
timeline.quote: each of them nervously jumping for the desert floor before fleeing as far from the train as possible.

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Kellan releases his vines and the train plunges off the cliff and explodes; Annie and Kellan escape on Fortune.
timeline.quote: Kellan released his vines with a gasp, and the train shot over the edge of the cliff

citation.work: Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity
citation.text: "Outlaws of Thunder Junction | Episode 3: A Train to Prosperity" by Akemi Dawn Bowman. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2024.

timeline.summary: Spitfire passes Far Fortune and a shark-man chordatan in the pits.
timeline.quote: Of all the other racers, Fortune is the only one that really intimidates Spitfire.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Far Fortune faces the demon's veil and unleashes the Endriders' blaze.
timeline.quote: And with that, she unleashes the blaze.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A pit opens under Mincemeat and the Endriders; she lands in Fortune's trunk.
timeline.quote: A yawning pit opens beneath her, one large enough to swallow Mincemeat and the five riders around her.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A giant dinosaur carrying a fortress and a dozen mounted lizardman raiders attack the trapped racers.
timeline.quote: There's a ramshackle fortress on its back comprised of three levels of wood and lizardmen.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace casts a spell of misty white that turns the wrecked racers' eyes white and makes them attack Chandra.
timeline.quote: Spirals of magic flash around Jace; a net of misty white surrounds the racers still pulling themselves from the wrecks.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Racers charge Chandra as one, including Captain Howler and Redshift.
